text: Proposition forty-five changes environmental review for
eligible construction projects.
The proposal offers an optional faster process for
specified projects, including many housing,
transportation,
water,
health, and clean-energy projects.
It changes deadlines and the scope of review
and litigation,
not just the speed of paperwork.
It is not automatic approval after a year.
A voter might support more predictable schedules and
fewer project-wide shutdowns, hoping to deliver homes and
infrastructure sooner.
Another voter could object to fewer alternatives,
tighter public participation, or narrower court and tribal
review.
Yes creates the optional new procedures;
no keeps existing review and challenge procedures.
Visit our website for the fuller explanation,
source links, and official voter guide.
